parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test files: 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/AppConfigurationTests.swift' (package: AppServices) and 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceHTTPTests.swift' (package: Metadata). Although the context_flags do not set is_test=true, the file paths unambiguously place both type-alias-object declarations inside test targets (the 'Tests/' directory segment and '*Tests.swift' naming convention). These are local test-support aliases for MockURLProtocol scoped to their respective test bundles; consolidating them would couple two otherwise independent test targets and provide no production benefit. The records carry no fields or signatures, making structural evidence for meaningful shared extraction absent.
